en: Welcome to Cortondo Gym! Katy's gym test is the olive roll, through the doors behind me.
Her course is blocked by Smoliv curled up into balls. Roll each one along to the end, and Katy will be waiting.
Congratulations on the Bug Badge! Artazon's gym is east of Mesagoza, and Levincia's is north of Artazon.
Katy's Bug types hate fire, flying and rock moves. Bring something that hits from above!
You beat Katy! Her pastries are almost as tough as her team. Almost.
